- All US Stocks, ETFs, and OTC

- Commodities
- Indices

Whether using this to catch early morning movements or opportunities throughout the day, Stock Alarm will enable you to easily track a range of stocks live, offering the ability to receive alerts through push notifications and / or phone calls.

Our premium membership will enable users to:
- Set an unlimited number of alarms and triggers
- Access premium customer support
- Allocation for a personal dedicated phone number, where someone calls when critical conditions are triggered
- Weekly tailored digest over email that includes micro and macroeconomic trends, price targets of monitored stocks, and opportunities in a variety of asset classes, including new technologies/developments
- Request new alerts and triggers

We continue to develop new features and iterate on the current product, so we encourage all users (free and premium) to suggest new features and provide feedback. Shake the phone with our app open or send in a request in settings to leave feedback.
